scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @dappfence/test-app
scripts.dev:http: npm run build && npm run dev:http -w @dappfence/test-app
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/run-ws.js test
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node scripts/run-ws.js test:coverage
scripts.build:watch: npm run build:watch -w @dappfence/core & npm run build:watch -w @dappfence/test-app
scripts.check: prettier --check "*.md" packages/ scripts/ docs/ && eslint packages/ scripts/ && node scripts/check-lock-integrity.js
scripts.publish:all: npm run check && npm run build:prod && npm publish --ws --access public
scripts.prepare: npm run check && npm run build:prod
scripts.ci:install: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.ci:local: npm run ci:install && npm run check && npm test
